answer_text:
For \(z\in[0,1]\),

\[
F_Z(z)=\mathbb{P}\left(\frac{Y}{X}\le z\right)
=\mathbb{P}(Y\le zX).
\]

On the triangle \(A=\{0\le y\le x\le 1\}\), the region \(Y\le zX\) is

\[
0\le y\le zx,\qquad 0\le x\le 1,
\]

since \(0\le z\le 1\). Therefore,

\[
F_Z(z)
=\int_0^1\int_0^{zx}2\,dy\,dx
=\int_0^1 2zx\,dx
=2z\left[\frac{x^2}{2}\right]_0^1
=z.
\]

Thus \(Z\) has a uniform distribution on \([0,1]\). Its cumulative distribution function is

\[
F_Z(z)=
\begin{cases}
0, & z<0,\\
z, & 0\le z\le 1,\\
1, & z>1,
\end{cases}
\]

and its density is

\[
f_Z(z)=\mathbf{1}_{[0,1]}(z).
\]

\[
\boxed{Z\sim \mathrm{Unif}(0,1),\qquad F_Z(z)=
\begin{cases}
0, & z<0,\\
z, & 0\le z\le 1,\\
1, & z>1.
\end{cases}}
\]
